name: Web Voices — subscription-driven Chrome voices
description: First-class provider plugin for subscription-driven web voices: chatgpt-web, gemini-web, grok-web, perplexity-web, claude-ai-web, aistudio-web, comet-web, notebooklm-web. Wraps DOM-fragile UI-intercept logic behind a versioned, contract-bound surface so vendor CSS-class changes can be patched in one place instead of breaking every user's bespoke scripts.

workstationLeaseFile.label: Workstation lease file
workstationLeaseFile.help: Single-writer lease so parallel voice calls don't clobber each other's Chrome session.

selectorRegistryPath.label: Selector registry path
selectorRegistryPath.help: JSON file with per-voice + per-version DOM selectors. Auto-patch on selector miss.

perVoiceTimeoutMs.label: Per-voice timeout
perVoiceTimeoutMs.help: Hard ceiling for a single web-voice call (DOM ready + reply received + content captured).

defaultProfilePort.label: Default Chrome profile port
defaultProfilePort.help: CDP port of the primary Chrome profile (typically 9222).
